fieldNotes.location: FACILITY NOT POSITIVELY RESOLVED. Roster geocode (32.747894,-96.923588 / 9222 W Jefferson Blvd) lands on a small empty dirt lot at a road intersection with auto-salvage lots and small commercial buildings — NOT an 800,000 sq ft distribution center. Public sources conflict: SupplierWiki HD DC list ties DC #5824 to 9222/9302 W Jefferson Blvd, while press coverage places HD's first FDC at 3730/4721 Mountain Creek Parkway, Dallas 75236. The coords used here (32.7415,-96.9755) are a best-estimate placement on the largest dock-and-drop-yard warehouse in the Mountain Creek industrial corridor, but it was NOT confirmed as HD-operated. Multiple large warehouses exist in this corridor and the FDC's distinctive drive-through tunnel was not clearly identifiable from satellite. Flag for human review / Google Maps place-ID lookup.
fieldNotes.classification: All classification values are inferred from the HD FDC archetype (press: 800,000 sq ft drive-through building handling 65-75 flatbeds/day, both-sides loading, 75-mile radius delivery) rather than confirmed imagery of the correct building. HD distribution facilities are universally gated; FDC throughput design implies long internal staging and bypass-lane room — hence fastLaneOpportunity true. dockDoors/dropArea bands reflect FDC scale assumptions.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: All counts are FDC-archetype estimates, not measured from confirmed imagery.
